summary: Implementation-only phase (no contract or architecture revision; runtime unchanged, Observed/observe/unavailable). Implemented IWPC-001 v1.4 SS35's frozen Post-Consumption Readiness Uniqueness contract (IWPC-REQ-197-209) exactly, closing Blocking Finding H-1's implementation defect. Root cause reconfirmed unchanged from Phase 145H.1's own description: FilesystemPendingReadinessStore.find_by_session_id excluded consumed/ records from its session-keyed lookup, the sole idempotency-by-key gate PublicationApplicationService.ensure_readiness_package/persist_readiness_package relied on. Rewrote find_by_session_id to search both the pending and consumed/ locations (IWPC-REQ-198) via a new private _list_consumed_package_ids enumeration helper mirroring the existing list_package_ids discipline, and to fail closed with the existing PendingReadinessStoreCorruptError/persistence_corrupt error path (no new error_type or exit code) if more than one record matches a given session_id across the two locations (IWPC-REQ-204). PublicationApplicationService and the decision-session readiness/status CLI handlers required no executable-line change: direct call-graph inspection confirmed their existing idempotent-by-key sequencing and output payload (disposition, record_id) already covered the consumed case once the lookup itself could reach it, independently confirming IWPC-REQ-200's own minimality prediction; only stale docstrings/comments describing the pre-repair limitation as permanent were corrected. 15 new/updated tests added across the store, application-service, and CLI layers, including a direct CLI-transport-level reproduction of Phase 145H's own original H-1 live-CLI sequence (readiness -> publish -> readiness again -> publish again), now asserting: no second package_id is ever minted; exactly one CHGR record file exists on disk before and after the repeated readiness call; the second publish is correctly rejected as publication_already_completed referencing the original record_id. Targeted regression (170 tests across the three modified test files) passed, 0 failed. fast_green -n auto: 4391 passed, 0 failed, identical to Phase 145H.1's carried-forward baseline. Full repository suite -n auto: 26,626 passed / 81 failed / 10 skipped; every failing test file independently reconfirmed pre-existing (missing optional 'build' packaging dependency; tasks/TODO.md's already-documented 137T staleness; an unrelated Phase 134E5 rendering-baseline assertion; an unrelated cltr_authority Typed Authority Model 'readiness'/'publication' naming collision sharing no code path with this phase's changes) by running each against unmodified main before attribution. No contract file was modified. No error_type, exit code, or transport shape changed. See docs/PHASE_145H2_POST_CONSUMPTION_READINESS_UNIQUENESS_IMPLEMENTATION_REPAIR.md.
